x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_inspect_project
x-alcomd-tools.title: Inspect a Unity project directory
x-alcomd-tools.description: Inspect a local Unity project without registering it. Use search-parents to inspect from a nested directory.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_refresh_project
x-alcomd-tools.title: Refresh a registered project
x-alcomd-tools.description: Refresh project metadata at the reviewed revision. Reuse the same key and parameters after an unknown receipt.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_set_project_favorite
x-alcomd-tools.title: Set project favorite
x-alcomd-tools.description: Set the favorite flag to the explicit boolean for the specified project revision.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_unregister_project
x-alcomd-tools.title: Remove a project registration
x-alcomd-tools.description: Remove the project from the registry and keep the project directory.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_project_delete_directory
x-alcomd-tools.title: Plan permanent project directory deletion
x-alcomd-tools.description: Preview permanent deletion of a registered project's directory. Review the exact path and writer evidence before applying.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_apply_project_delete_directory
x-alcomd-tools.title: Apply confirmed project directory deletion
x-alcomd-tools.description: Permanently delete the exact directory identified by a reviewed plan. Use the original plan ID and revision.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_project_unity_migration
x-alcomd-tools.title: Plan a project Unity migration
x-alcomd-tools.description: Preview migrating the project to the chosen registered Unity installation.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_apply_project_unity_migration
x-alcomd-tools.title: Apply a confirmed Unity migration
x-alcomd-tools.description: Apply the original reviewed migration plan. Inspect the returned operation to determine the outcome.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_get_plan
x-alcomd-tools.title: Read an original plan
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read this caller's frozen package, copy, directory deletion, or Unity migration plan by kind and ID.

sourceUrl.description: Anonymous HTTPS; no userinfo or fragment; legal query preserved.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_query_project_candidates
x-alcomd-tools.title: Query project package candidates
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read candidate versions or summaries including Core recommendations, source filters, and reviewed bulk intents. Pass through the original cursor on subsequent pages.

Candidate.description: Core applies source and prerelease visibility before producing this record. Closed sources and policy-excluded prerelease versions are never returned as disabled candidate records.

unity.$comment: Same numeric package minimum as Plan: unity plus optional unityRelease, a/b/f/p; absent unity adds no minimum, uninterpretable values stay unknown. Legacy metadata alone is not proof that cleanup is required.

manual_unity_override_allowed.description: Core qualification for explicit manual root selection only. Does not grant automatic or bulk eligibility.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_list_user_packages
x-alcomd-tools.title: List local user packages
x-alcomd-tools.description: List registered local packages available as sources for project plans.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_get_user_package
x-alcomd-tools.title: Inspect a local user package
x-alcomd-tools.description: Read one registered local package and its current revision.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_enroll_user_package
x-alcomd-tools.title: Register a local package directory
x-alcomd-tools.description: Register the reviewed package directory as a local source for project plans.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_refresh_user_package
x-alcomd-tools.title: Refresh a local user package
x-alcomd-tools.description: Refresh the registered local package at the reviewed revision.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_remove_user_package
x-alcomd-tools.title: Remove a local user package registration
x-alcomd-tools.description: Remove the source registration and keep the local package directory.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_register_project
x-alcomd-tools.title: Register an existing project
x-alcomd-tools.description: Register a project under the default project directory or by its absolute path on the Core machine.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_create_project
x-alcomd-tools.title: Create a project
x-alcomd-tools.description: Create a project under the default project directory or an explicit absolute parent directory on the Core machine. Supply the project name separately and optionally select a template.

x-alcomd-tools.name: alcomd_plan_project_copy
x-alcomd-tools.title: Review a project copy
x-alcomd-tools.description: Freeze and return the source revision and destination for review. Supply a project name under the default project directory or an explicit absolute parent directory on the Core machine.
